detail.name: Term Deposit
detail.description: A Term Deposit is an investment account where the interest rate is guaranteed not to change for the whole of the nominated term. It gives you the security of knowing that your interest income is protected against changes in market conditions.

features.additionalValue: Pre-maturity notification sent via letter. Members can also opt-in to notification via SMS and / or email.

fees.name: Early Redemption
fees.additionalInfo: If you withdraw your Term Deposit before the maturity date, an Early Redemption fee (i.e. Early redemption interest adjustment) will apply based on the proportion of the term completed. An early redemption notice period also applies.

detail.description: Our Everyday Mortgage Offset Account is designed exclusively for members with an eligible RACQ Bank variable home loan. It is a 100% offset account that allows members to use their savings to reduce the interest and term on their home loan. The funds in your Everyday Mortgage Offset Account are 'at call', allowing complete flexibility and providing benefits to your residential mortgage.
